info.title: CF Meet Developer Platform API
info.description: Section 50 developer / enterprise control plane, served through the public API Gateway. Human console operations use the verified CF Meet session (verified by the Meeting Service through the session bridge); server automation uses scoped Platform Access credentials where noted. Organizations, projects and environments are Developer Platform metadata over canonical Platform Access tenants, applications and environments: Platform Access remains the only identity, credential and scope authority. Non-members get NOT_FOUND for another tenant's resources. Every response carries X-Request-Id. Section 53 central webhooks: the Developer Console manages an environment's webhook subscriptions, delivery and attempt history and replays under /v1/environments/{environmentId}/webhooks* and /webhook-deliveries/*. The machine-credential webhook API keeps Calling's public contract and paths (cfmeet.calling.http-api /v1/webhooks*); the API Gateway re-points it to the Developer Platform at the cut-over (cfmeet.developer-platform.internal-api documents the served routes).

get.summary: List the caller's organizations (a machine credential sees only its own)
get.description: List the caller's organizations (a machine credential sees only its own). Roles: any member. Machine credentials need `organizations.read`.

post.summary: Create an organization; the creator becomes its OWNER
post.description: Create an organization; the creator becomes its OWNER. Platform Access creates the canonical EXTERNAL tenant.

get.summary: Read an organization (including its Platform Access classification)
get.description: Read an organization (including its Platform Access classification). Roles: any member. Machine credentials need `organizations.read`.

patch.description: Update the organization profile (optimistic concurrency). Roles: OWNER, ADMIN. Machine credentials need `organizations.manage`.

post.summary: Close the organization (terminal; machine access is withdrawn in Platform Access first)
post.description: Close the organization (terminal; machine access is withdrawn in Platform Access first). Roles: OWNER.

get.description: List human workspace members. Roles: any member. Machine credentials need `organizations.read`.

patch.summary: Change a member's role (the last OWNER can never be demoted)
patch.description: Change a member's role (the last OWNER can never be demoted). Roles: OWNER.

delete.summary: Remove a member (OWNER) or leave (self); never the last OWNER
delete.description: Remove a member (OWNER) or leave (self); never the last OWNER. Roles: OWNER, or the member themself.

post.summary: Transfer ownership: the target member becomes OWNER and the caller becomes ADMIN, atomically
post.description: Transfer ownership: the target member becomes OWNER and the caller becomes ADMIN, atomically. Roles: OWNER.

get.description: List invitations (tokens are never returned). Roles: any member.

post.summary: Invite a person by email; the one-time token is returned only in this response
post.description: Invite a person by email; the one-time token is returned only in this response. Roles: OWNER.
Revoke a pending invitation. Roles: OWNER.

post.summary: Accept an invitation with its one-time token; the session's verified email must equal the invited address
post.description: Accept an invitation with its one-time token; the session's verified email must equal the invited address.

get.description: List projects. Roles: any member. Machine credentials need `projects.read`.

post.summary: Create a project; Platform Access creates the canonical application
post.description: Create a project; Platform Access creates the canonical application. Roles: OWNER, ADMIN. Machine credentials need `projects.manage`.

get.description: Read a project. Roles: any member. Machine credentials need `projects.read`.

patch.description: Update project metadata (optimistic concurrency). Roles: OWNER, ADMIN. Machine credentials need `projects.manage`.

post.summary: Archive the project (terminal): the Platform Access application is suspended; no communications-domain data is deleted
post.description: Archive the project (terminal): the Platform Access application is suspended; no communications-domain data is deleted. Roles: OWNER, ADMIN. Machine credentials need `projects.manage`.

post.summary: Suspend the project (its Platform Access application is suspended)
post.description: Suspend the project (its Platform Access application is suspended). Roles: OWNER, ADMIN. Machine credentials need `projects.manage`.
Resume a suspended project. Roles: OWNER, ADMIN. Machine credentials need `projects.manage`.

get.summary: The project's scope grants as Platform Access reports them
get.description: The project's scope grants as Platform Access reports them. Roles: any member. Machine credentials need `projects.read`.
List the project's environments. Roles: any member. Machine credentials need `projects.read`.

post.summary: Create a SANDBOX or TEST environment (Platform Access creates the canonical environment)
post.description: Create a SANDBOX or TEST environment (Platform Access creates the canonical environment). Roles: OWNER, ADMIN. Machine credentials need `projects.manage`.

get.summary: Read an environment with its Platform Access status
get.description: Read an environment with its Platform Access status. Roles: any member. Machine credentials need `projects.read`.

post.description: Suspend a non-production environment. Roles: OWNER, ADMIN. Machine credentials need `projects.manage`.
Resume a suspended non-production environment. Roles: OWNER, ADMIN. Machine credentials need `projects.manage`.

get.summary: Effective platform entitlements (API request quotas) of an environment
get.description: Effective platform entitlements (API request quotas) of an environment. Roles: OWNER, ADMIN, DEVELOPER, ANALYST. Machine credentials need `usage.read`.

get.summary: Immutable activity history of the organization, newest first
get.description: Immutable activity history of the organization, newest first. Roles: OWNER, ADMIN, ANALYST. Machine credentials need `audit.read`.

get.summary: Current plan assignment(s) and billing-account reference
get.description: Current plan assignment(s) and billing-account reference. Roles: OWNER, ADMIN, BILLING.

get.summary: Immutable effective history of plan assignments
get.description: Immutable effective history of plan assignments. Roles: OWNER, ADMIN, BILLING.

put.summary: Create or update the billing-account reference (RETAIL / CONTRACT)
put.description: Create or update the billing-account reference (RETAIL / CONTRACT). No payment data is accepted. Roles: OWNER, BILLING.

get.summary: Active commercial plan versions (entitlement profiles; no prices)
get.description: Active commercial plan versions (entitlement profiles; no prices).

get.summary: List the webhook subscriptions of an environment
get.description: Subscriptions of the environment with their origin and endpoint health. Roles: OWNER, ADMIN, DEVELOPER, ANALYST (Developer Console session only).

200.description: A page of subscriptions (never a secret).

post.summary: Create a webhook subscription in an environment
post.description: Server-generated signing secret, returned ONCE (an Idempotency-Key replay returns the subscription without it). Roles: OWNER, ADMIN, DEVELOPER (Developer Console session only); refused while the organization is restricted, suspended or closed.

201.description: The subscription and its signing secret.

get.summary: Get a webhook subscription of an environment
get.description: Another environment's subscription is 404. Roles: OWNER, ADMIN, DEVELOPER, ANALYST (Developer Console session only).

patch.summary: Update a webhook subscription of an environment
patch.description: expectedVersion is required (stale: 409 VERSION_CONFLICT). Re-enabling resets the endpoint health. Roles: OWNER, ADMIN, DEVELOPER (Developer Console session only); refused while the organization is restricted, suspended or closed.

delete.summary: Delete a webhook subscription of an environment
delete.description: Soft delete: open deliveries are CANCELLED; history is kept. Roles: OWNER, ADMIN, DEVELOPER (Developer Console session only); refused while the organization is restricted, suspended or closed.

parameters.name: expectedVersion
parameters.description: The subscription version the change is based on (stale: 409 VERSION_CONFLICT).

post.summary: Rotate the signing secret of a subscription
post.description: The new secret is returned ONCE. Roles: OWNER, ADMIN, DEVELOPER (Developer Console session only); refused while the organization is restricted, suspended or closed.

200.description: The subscription and its new signing secret.

get.description: Delivery history (FAILED dead letters, SHADOW records of shadow mode). Roles: OWNER, ADMIN, DEVELOPER, ANALYST (Developer Console session only).

get.summary: List the attempts of a delivery
get.description: Status class and bounded error class of every attempt (never a response body). Roles: OWNER, ADMIN, DEVELOPER, ANALYST (Developer Console session only).

post.description: A NEW delivery of the same event (same event id) to the same active subscription; dead letters included. Roles: OWNER, ADMIN, DEVELOPER (Developer Console session only); refused while the organization is restricted, suspended or closed.

userSession.description: The signed-in developer's CF Meet session (Developer Console). Never a machine credential.

platformCredential.description: A Platform Access API credential (server-side only; never in a browser).

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Replays return the original response; reuse with a different request is IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED. One-time secrets are never replayed.
